text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT — elevated 5xx rate from model-serving-proxy in us-west1. Trigger: error-rate > 8% for 3m. Page sent to #oncall.

alex: seeing huge spikes in proxy 5xx, latency also up. Tentative root: network path errors to worker pool. Metrics: 5xx 12%, p95 latency 720ms.

priya: filing the Incident and kicking off escalation. Drafting status page now.

sam: copying recent logs — short dump: ```
2026-03-15T09:10:12Z proxy.us-west1 502 upstream reset
2026-03-15T09:11:02Z proxy.us-west1 504 connection timeout
```

alex: looks like upstream GCP LB || interconnect flaps. Jordan from infra is on call but OOO — escalating to cloud vendor. @priya can you open a support case with packet traces and flow logs?

priya: on it. Case created: GCP-CASE-449812. Sent packet captures and `gcloud compute` logs. Requested urgent network team engagement.

priya: draft status page update (please review):
"""
We are investigating increased error rates affecting inference requests in the us-west1 region. Some customers may see failed requests or increased latency. Our engineers are actively investigating and working with our cloud provider. Updates every 15 minutes.
"""

emma: LGTM. Add an explicit mitigation note: we are routing new requests away from us-west1 for affected customers while we investigate.

alex: rolling a temporary routing rule to prefer us-east1 for non-data-resident tenants. Command used: ```sh
redwood-cli route update --priority lower --region-preference us-east1 --selector "!data_resident"
```

sam: live: traffic shift started at 09:18 UTC. Monitoring latency and error rate. Early signal: error down to 4% for redirected traffic.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-20260315-009 — Severity P1. Owner: alex. Notify: #incidents, #customer-notifications.

alex: quick customer comm draft (for priority customers):
"""
Hi — we're currently experiencing intermittent failures for inference requests routed to our us-west1 cluster. We're actively mitigating by routing traffic to alternate regions and we've engaged our cloud provider. We will follow up within 60 minutes with an update. We apologize for the disruption.
"""

priya: added to status page and sent to customer-facing team for review. Creating a short API customers broadcast and a different message for enterprise accounts with SLA notes.

sam: update from GCP: `gcp-support`: "we see a partial fabric disruption impacting a subset of VMs in us-west1. Network team assigned. ETA initial findings 30m. Link to ticket: https://gcp.example/ticket/GCP-CASE-449812"

alex: ok — since vendor ETA is 30m, let's keep routing in place and keep customers posted. Priya, please prepare an incident timeline template for postmortem (include timestamps for detection, mitigation steps, vendor report, customer notifications).

priya: will do. Draft timeline added to the incident doc. Also preparing internal comms template for execs: short summary, impact, mitigation, next steps, customer outreach plan.

emma: i'm taking on-call now — handoff: issue, mitigation (region routing), vendor case GCP-CASE-449812, action items: monitor error rate <5% target, hold on traffic reflow until vendor confirms stable fabric. Reassign owner to emma.

alex: thanks, @emma — passing baton. I'm staying as secondary.

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Handoff logged (from alex to emma) at 09:28 UTC.

emma: ping @gcp-support for ETA update and ask for any temporary BGP/routing fixes we can apply to avoid longer-term customer impact.

gcp-support: "Thanks — network team investigating. Quick ask: can you confirm any recent BGP changes or maintenance windows? We see flaps on two ToR switches. We'll push a mitigation if confirmed. We'll update within 20m."

sam: scheduling a 30m incident sync call for 09:35 UTC with infra, support, and customer ops. Dial-in posted in thread.

priya: customer comm version for enterprise (SLA note):
"""
We are escalating an operational incident affecting requests in us-west1. We have routed traffic to alternate regions to reduce impact and opened a priority case with our cloud provider. We will follow up with a detailed timeline and root cause analysis. Please open a support ticket if you need immediate assistance.
"""

emma: noted. I'll update the status page when we have confirmation from GCP of successful mitigation. For now: keep customers informed every 30m.

alex: adding runbook note: if vendor ETA slips beyond 60m, prepare to expand region routing to data-resident customers with legal/product signoff.

oncall-bot: next scheduled update reminder in 15m.

(priya reacted :thumbsup: to GCP update)

sam: logging this for the postmortem: timeline, vendor communications, traffic reroute commands, status page texts, customer templates, exec comms.

emma: current state: mitigation in progress, monitoring. Will post next update after vendor confirmation or at 09:45 UTC.

gcp-support: "Network team reports forced switchover of affected ToRs applied. We're seeing packet loss drop to normal levels. We'll continue to monitor and report back."

sam: observed: p95 latency back to 220ms, 5xx down to 1.2% overall. Great.

emma: marking incident state -> mitigated (partial) in incident doc. Preparing final customer follow-up draft and RCA checklist.

alex: thanks everyone — great coordination. We'll keep this thread for the postmortem write-up.
